cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: A warm feeling spread through me when I saw Dad.
cards.example_zh: 见到爸爸时，一股温暖的感觉涌遍了全身。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: Our babysitter read stories until my parents came home.
cards.example_zh: 保姆一直讲故事，直到我父母回到家。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: His polite behavior impressed the guests at dinner.
cards.example_zh: 他有礼貌的行为让晚餐上的客人印象深刻。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: Consider the weather before you leave for the picnic.

cards.example_zh: 设计师试了三种队徽，球队才选定了星星那一款。

cards.example_zh: 学校拍照前，理发师给我修了刘海。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings

cards.example_zh: 一位亲戚从老家带来了月饼。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: The science assessment includes a short lab report.
cards.example_zh: 科学评估包括一份简短的实验报告。

cards.example_zh: 星期天，学生可以免费进入博物馆。

cards.example_en: Juice consumption in our canteen doubles when the weather is hot.
cards.example_zh: 天气一热，我们食堂的果汁消费就会翻倍。
